question: What’s the closest fast food aligned with the route to Sugar Brook Field Trial and Wildlife Management Area, Plainfield, CT from Cardiovascular Institute of New England, Cranston, RI?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.472092 41.786868)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.940538 41.716725)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.472092 41.786868)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.472092 41.786868)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
